sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where to read breach notices from.

enumTitles: California AG breach list + sample letters

lookbackDays.title: Look back (days)
lookbackDays.description: Notices published in the last N days. Schedule the actor hourly with 1-2 days to catch breaches as they post.

maxNoticesPerSource.title: Max notices per source
maxNoticesPerSource.description: Most notices to read from each source per run. Keeps cost bounded on a long lookback.

onlyNames.title: Only these defendants
onlyNames.description: Optional. Restrict to organisations whose name contains one of these strings.

draftComplaints.title: Draft complaints
draftComplaints.description: Draft a complaint for each incident scoring at or above the threshold. Charged per draft.

minScoreForDraft.title: Minimum triage score to draft
minScoreForDraft.description: Only incidents scoring at least this (0-100) get a complaint draft, the $19 event. Lower it to draft more, raise it to draft only the strongest.

anthropicApiKey.title: Your Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropicApiKey.description: Leave empty to use ours (included in the draft price).
